title: Walsh characters have unit norm
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq [n]$. Under the uniform measure on the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$, the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_S$ satisfies
\[
  \langle \chi_S, \chi_S\rangle \;=\; 2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n} \chi_S(x)^2 \;=\; 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a subset of [n] (a finite set of coordinates)
